findings.title: Transient sub-120px hit window for NEW GAME during pop-in before the proxy wraps
findings.evidence: for _i in range(300): await get_tree().process_frame ... if is_instance_valid(reset) and _reset_proxy != null: _reset_proxy.wrap(reset, FinLitTouchTargets.Role.SECONDARY)
findings.detail: Between _open_popup (which retires the proxy) and the settle loop's wrap, the 110px button is live and sub-floor (~0.3s typical, up to the 300-frame budget). Disclosed in the PR body as an accepted trade-off.
findings.recommended_fix: reset.disabled = true (or MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE) until the wrap completes, or accept as disclosed.

findings.title: Dominant button press dispatch (_on_dominant_pressed) never exercised by any test
findings.evidence: func _on_dominant_pressed() -> void: ... var action := FinLitTouchTargets.dominant_action(_state) ... match action["action"]
findings.detail: AC3 makes dominant_action() the single source for text, enabled, AND press dispatch, but only the label path is pinned — a swapped match arm would pass the suite.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a scene stage driving the press per action (FIND_WORK / FIX / WORK_SHIFT) asserting the correct handler fires.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: P0 100% (A29 rules + scene enforcement incl. real-input routing + negative control); P1 ~86% — the two gaps above (press dispatch, WORK SHIFT cooldown state) keep the gate at CONCERNS.
findings.recommended_fix: Drive the dominant press per action and assert the cooldown-disabled state; that lifts the gate to PASS.

findings.title: Touch floors hardcoded in 4 places; the pure rules module is not the single source the UI consumes
findings.evidence: MIN_TOUCH_PRIMARY := 160 / Button/constants/min_touch_size = 160 / custom_minimum_size = Vector2(160, 200) / button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(120, 150)
findings.detail: 160 appears in the rules module + scene; 120 in the rules module, theme, and _make_big_button. Drift risk without a shared constant. Partially disclosed in the PR body (theme mirrors are deliberate; scene pins are test-enforced: 'dominant button combined min (197.0, 200.0) meets the 160px primary floor').
findings.recommended_fix: Consume the theme constants via theme.get_constant in _make_big_button / the dominant button, or document the scene pins as the enforcement contract.

findings.title: first_upgradeable returns -1 on an id-less affordable asset instead of skipping to later candidates
findings.evidence: if cost >= 0 and state.get("balance", 0) >= cost: return int(asset.get("id", -1))
findings.detail: Ragged state would fall through to WORK SHIFT, skipping a valid later upgrade. Latent: ids are always present today; asymmetric with oldest_damaged_repairable's guard.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the same id<0 continue guard as oldest_damaged_repairable.

findings.title: Touch proxy emits pressed on press-down only; no release-inside / drag-off-cancel path
findings.evidence: if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT: pressed.emit()
findings.detail: The wrapped Button cancels on drag-off (default release-with-cancel); the proxy fires on press-down. A press on the enlarged rect then drag-off still fires NEW GAME. Arguably intentional for touch responsiveness — flag for the record.
findings.recommended_fix: If release semantics are wanted, track press origin and emit only when release lands inside the rect.

findings.title: Asset-card OPEN button (170x130) size not enforced by any test
findings.detail: AC5's 'every interactive target enforced by tests' doesn't cover the asset-card OPEN button; it meets the floors today (170x130) but nothing pins it.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend the combined-minimum scene checks to the asset-card OPEN/FIX buttons.
